summary: The test suite provides solid unit test coverage of core glob-matching, rule-loading, and label-resolution logic using Pester (Convert-GlobToRegex, Test-PathMatchesGlob, Import-LabelRules, Get-FileLabels, Get-PrLabels all have test cases). Workflow structure tests verify YAML syntax and job composition. However, critical gaps undermine the suite's completeness: (1) No act-based integration tests whatsoever, despite the task explicitly requiring 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT', no act-result.txt generation, and no verification of 'Job succeeded' messages; (2) CLI entrypoint testing is absent—OutputFormat parameter, parameter binding, GITHUB_OUTPUT/GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY integration are not tested; (3) Edge cases are sparse (no '?' glob wildcard test, no unicode/special-character handling, no empty-rules or zero-file scenarios beyond basics); (4) Tests depend on Python's yaml module for workflow parsing (external dependency); (5) The glob regex conversion lacks negative test cases. The tests would catch regressions in core label logic but would miss integration failures, missing environment variables, malformed CLI invocations, and many boundary conditions. The requirement to run all tests through act and validate act's output against known-good values is entirely unmet.
